notes: Typecheck passed on the swapped tree; the swap was reverted. Real mouse hover was unreliable in the shared browser, so comparison used keyboard focus and DOM measurement. 390x844 not checked: resized, but the tooltip did not open in the scripted run. Hover-persistence, outside click and scroll lock not checked. Escape closes the tooltip and focus stays on the trigger on the Base UI build; not verified on the reference.
reasonNotMoved: Swapping to the base-nova tooltip changes look and screen-reader output. Content sits 4-6px closer to the trigger (sideOffset 4 against Radix's 10px including arrow), the arrow box is 14px instead of 10px, Base UI emits no role=tooltip and no aria-describedby on the trigger, and every tooltip animates rather than only the first. Retry once the base-nova tooltip can be configured to match (offset, arrow, aria) or the team accepts these as intended changes. Related open issues: https://github.com/mui/base-ui/issues/3075 and https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/issues/9617.
